_meta.critical: BORI/Poona critical edition (MBh03.txt, John Smith/Tokunaga e-text)
_meta.method: content alignment of canonicalized IAST verses (difflib), book-level

_caveat: Use per_adhyaya_aligned (adhyayas matched by verse content). per_adhyaya_by_number_RAW compares by adhyaya NUMBER and is misleading once numbering diverges. identical/variant/only counts are content-based; near-identical verses with minor orthographic/sandhi differences inflate 'variant' and 'only' buckets — the reliable absence signal is the large contiguous vulgate_only runs.
